notes: Read SKILL.md in full. Installs or updates the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit when the user asks: runs 'npx -y --package @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli atk --version', which downloads the latest CLI, and 'code --install-extension TeamsDevApp.ms-teams-vscode-extension'.

Risk raised to medium although the scanner rates it low: the npx package version is not pinned, so the code it executes changes over time. It also sets ATK_CLI_SKILL=true to tag CLI telemetry. The skill requires the exact official package and extension names and reporting failures.
Installing this skill does not run anything; the commands run only when the user asks to install or update ATK.
